If,

'B % D' means 'B is brother of D',

'B & D' means 'B is the mother of D',

'B × D' means 'B is the husband of D',

'B # D' means 'B is sister of D',

'B $ D' means 'B is the son of D',

'B @ D' means 'B is the father of D',

So how is A related to E in the given expression?

A % D $ F # B % E × S
questions.solution:
Given expression: 'A % D $ F # B % E × S'

A is the brother of D, D is the son of F, F is the sister of B, B is the brother of E and E is the husband of S.

Here, A is the nephew of E.

questions.question: Which two numbers and two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct? 7 × 14 ÷ 6 + 12 + 6 = 30
questions.questionHtml:
Which two numbers and two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct? 

7 × 14 ÷ 6 + 12 + 6 = 30
questions.solution:
(2) 7 and 14, × and ÷

⇒ 7 × 14 ÷ 6 + 12 + 6 = 30

After interchanging the sign and number:

⇒ 14 ÷ 7 × 6 + 12 + 6 = 30

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 2 × 6 + 12 + 6

⇒ 12 + 12 + 6

⇒ 24 + 6 = 30

⇒ '14 ÷ 7 × 6 + 12 + 6 = 30'

questions.solution:
(1) +, -, ×, +, ÷, ×

⇒ 321 * 3 * 236 * 5 * 248 * 4 * 20 = 384

After putting the signs:

⇒ 321 + 3 - 236 × 5 + 248 ÷ 4 × 20 = 384

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 321 + 3 - 236 × 5 + 62 × 20

⇒ 321 + 3 - 1180 + 1240

⇒ 1564 - 1180 = 384

⇒ '321 + 3 - 236 × 5 + 248 ÷ 4 × 20 = 384'

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution stipulates that the law declared by the Supreme Court shall be binding on all courts within the territory of India?
questions.questionHtml: Which Article of the Indian Constitution stipulates that the law declared by the Supreme Court shall be binding on all courts within the territory of India?
questions.solution: Article 141 of the Indian Constitution states that the law declared by the Supreme Court shall be binding on all courts within the territory of India. This means that all lower courts, including High Courts, must abide by the decisions and rulings made by the Supreme Court.The purpose of this article is to ensure consistency and uniformity in the interpretation and application of laws across the country.

questions.question: Who among the following Sultans of Delhi started the system of Sijda and Paibos?
questions.questionHtml: Who among the following Sultans of Delhi started the system of Sijda and Paibos?
questions.solution: The correct answer is option 3, i.e. Ghiyas ud din Balban, who was the ninth Sultan of Delhi and ruled from 1266 to 1287 AD. Sijda and Paibos were two forms of obeisance that were introduced by Balban to establish his authority and enhance the status of the Sultanate in the eyes of the people. Sijda involved prostrating oneself before the Sultan and touching his feet as a sign of submission and respect. Paibos, on the other hand, required the person to kneel before the Sultan and kiss his feet.

It is a futuristic creature inspired by the Japanese folklore of "Koma Inu" or guardian lions. Someity represents the Paralympic athletes who overcome obstacles and strive for excellence.

questions.solution: Pandit Kishan Maharaj of Benaras Gharana was a tabla player.He was born on September 3, 1923, in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. He was awarded the Padma Shri in 1973 and the Padma Bhushan in 1991 for his contribution to Indian classical music.

questions.question: Identify the last element from the fifth period.
questions.questionHtml: Identify the last element from the fifth period.
questions.solution: The fifth period of the periodic table consists of 18 elements, starting from Rubidium (Rb) and ending with Xenon (Xe). Helium (He) is the first element in the periodic table and is located in the first period. It is not a part of the fifth period. Helium (He) is a noble gas and is the second most abundant element in the universe after hydrogen. It is used in cryogenics, welding, and as a coolant in nuclear reactors.

questions.question: The largest freshwater lake of India is ______.
questions.questionHtml: The largest freshwater lake of India is ______.
questions.solution: Wular Lake is located in the state of Jammu and Kashmir and is the largest freshwater lake in India. It covers an area of around 189 sq. km. The lake is situated at an altitude of 1,580 meters above sea level and is surrounded by majestic mountains.Wular Lake is an important source of livelihood for the local people as it supports a variety of fish species.

questions.question: Which of the following rights is guaranteed by Article 25 of the Indian Constitution?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following rights is guaranteed by Article 25 of the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution: Article 25 of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to freedom of religion to all citizens of India. This means that every individual has the freedom to practice, profess, and propagate any religion of their choice.The Constitution also allows for the freedom to manage religious affairs subject to public order, morality and health.

questions.question: Which water body separates Andaman in the north and Nicobar in the south?
questions.questionHtml: Which water body separates Andaman in the north and Nicobar in the south?
questions.solution: The correct answer is option 1, Ten Degree Channel, which separates Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The Ten Degree Channel is a narrow strip of water that runs between the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and is approximately 150 km wide.The channel got its name as it lies on the 10th degree of north latitude.

questions.question: Who among the following Mauryan rulers conquered Kalinga?
questions.questionHtml: Who among the following Mauryan rulers conquered Kalinga?
questions.solution: The correct answer to the question is Option 1, Ashoka.: Ashoka was the third ruler of the Mauryan dynasty who conquered Kalinga in 261 BCE. The Kalinga war was a turning point in Ashoka's life as it made him realize the futility of war and violence and he embraced Buddhism.

questions.question: The term 'Straight drive’ is related to which of the following sports?
questions.questionHtml: The term 'Straight drive’ is related to which of the following sports?
questions.solution: A straight drive is a type of shot in cricket where the batsman hits the ball straight down the ground, along the pitch, towards the bowler.It is considered one of the most elegant and classic shots in cricket. Hockey, football, and badminton do not have a shot or move called a straight drive.

questions.question: Which organic compound has a pleasant almond aroma that is commonly used to impart almond flavour to chocolate and baked goods?
questions.questionHtml: Which organic compound has a pleasant almond aroma that is commonly used to impart almond flavour to chocolate and baked goods?
questions.solution: Benzaldehyde is an organic compound with a pleasant almond aroma that is commonly used to impart almond flavor to chocolate and baked goods. It is a colorless liquid with a characteristic almond-like odor. Benzaldehyde is also used as a flavoring agent in foods and beverages, as well as in perfumes and cosmetics.

It is a measure of the net value of goods and services produced by a country's residents after accounting for the wear and tear on capital goods used in production.

questions.question: Sikhs celebrate the day of release from prison (Bandi Chhor Diwas) with which of these Hindu festivals?
questions.questionHtml: Sikhs celebrate the day of release from prison (Bandi Chhor Diwas) with which of these Hindu festivals?
questions.solution: The correct answer is option 3, i.e., Diwali. The Sikh community celebrates Bandi Chhor Divas on the same day as Diwali.Sikhism is a monotheistic religion founded in the 15th century in Punjab, India. The religion is based on the teachings of Guru Nanak and nine other Sikh gurus who followed him.Bandi Chhor Divas is a Sikh festival that marks the release of Guru Hargobind Sahib from the Gwalior Fort along with 52 other Rajput kings.

questions.question: Under the PL 480 scheme, India used to import wheat from which country?
questions.questionHtml: Under the PL 480 scheme, India used to import wheat from which country?
questions.solution: Under the PL 480 scheme, India used to import wheat from the United States of America (USA). The PL 480 scheme was a food aid program initiated by the USA in the 1950s to provide surplus agricultural commodities to developing countries.The scheme was also known as "Food for Peace" and aimed to alleviate hunger and poverty in recipient countries.

questions.question: Which crop is grown during the Zaid season in India?
questions.questionHtml: Which crop is grown during the Zaid season in India?
questions.solution: Zaid season is the summer cropping season in India, which starts in March and lasts till June.During this season, crops that require less water and have a shorter growth duration are grown. Cucumber is a popular crop grown during the Zaid season as it has a short growth duration of 50-60 days and requires less water.

questions.question: Kalakshetra style is associated with which Indian classical dance form?
questions.questionHtml: Kalakshetra style is associated with which Indian classical dance form?
questions.solution: Bharatanatyam is a classical dance form that originated in Tamil Nadu, India and is known for its intricate footwork, hand gestures, facial expressions, and body movements.Kalakshetra is a renowned dance institution in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, founded in 1936 by Rukmini Devi Arundale, a prominent dancer and theosophist. The institution is dedicated to the promotion and preservation of Bharatanatyam and other Indian classical art forms.

questions.question: When and at which place did the Jallianwala Bagh massacre take place?
questions.questionHtml: When and at which place did the Jallianwala Bagh massacre take place?
questions.solution: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place on 13 April 1919 in Amritsar, Punjab.It was a brutal incident where British troops fired on a crowd of unarmed Indian civilians who had gathered in Jallianwala Bagh to protest against the arrest and deportation of two national leaders.

questions.question: V Satyanarayana Sarma, a Padma Shri awardee, was recognised for which of the following dance forms?
questions.questionHtml: V Satyanarayana Sarma, a Padma Shri awardee, was recognised for which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: V Satyanarayana Sarma was recognized for Kuchipudi, a classical dance form originating in the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.Kuchipudi is known for its intricate footwork, graceful movements, and expressive facial expressions. Hence, the correct answer to the question is option 4, Kuchipudi.

questions.question: Which of the following cities of Nepal does NOT have a branch of ‘Indian Citizen’s Association of Nepal’?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following cities of Nepal does NOT have a branch of ‘Indian Citizen’s Association of Nepal’?

questions.question: An inlet pipe can fill an empty tank in \(4\frac{1}{2}\) hours while an outlet pipe drains a completely filled tank in \(7\frac{1}{5}\) hours. The tank is initially empty. and the two pipes are alternately opened for an hour each, till the tank is completely filled, starting with the inlet pipe. In how many hours will the tank be completely filled?
questions.questionHtml: An inlet pipe can fill an empty tank in \(4\frac{1}{2}\) hours while an outlet pipe drains a completely filled tank in \(7\frac{1}{5}\) hours. The tank is initially empty. and the two pipes are alternately opened for an hour each, till the tank is completely filled, starting with the inlet pipe. In how many hours will the tank be completely filled?
questions.solution:
Let the total work is 36 units 

The efficiency of the inlet pipe is 36× 2/9 = 8 units

The efficiency of the outlet pipe is 36 × 5 /36  = 5 units

The efficiency of pipe both is 8 - 5= 3 units

In 2 hours the tank is filled with 3 units 

So 30 units will be filled in 10 × 2 = 20 hours 

The remaining 6 unit will be filled by the inlet pipe by 6/8 = 3/4 hr

Total time is \(20\frac{3}{4}\)

questions.question: Two pipes S1 and S2 alone can fill an empty tank in 15 hours and 20 hours respectively. Pipe S3 alone can empty that completely filled tank in 40 hours. Firstly both pipes S1 and S2 are opened and after 2 hour pipe S3 is also opened. In how much time tank will be completely filled after S3 is opened?
questions.questionHtml: Two pipes S1 and S2 alone can fill an empty tank in 15 hours and 20 hours respectively. Pipe S3 alone can empty that completely filled tank in 40 hours. Firstly both pipes S1 and S2 are opened and after 2 hour pipe S3 is also opened. In how much time tank will be completely filled after S3 is opened?
questions.solution:
Let total work is 120 units ( LCM of 15 , 20 and 40) 

The efficiency of pipe s1 is 120 /15 = 8 units . The efficiency of pipe s2 is 120 / 20  = 6 units

The efficiency of pipe S1 + S2 is  8 + 6= 14 units. In 2 hrs they will fill 14 × 2 = 28 units

Remaining amount 120 - 28 = 92 units. The efficiency of pipe s3 is 120 / 40  = - 3 units

Now combined efficiency of all three pipes is 14 - 3 = 11 units

Time to fill remaining 92 units is , 92 / 11 hr

questions.question: Amit can complete a piece of work in 5 hours; Jeevan and Paul together can complete It In 4 hours, while Amit and Paul together can complete It In 3 hours. Approximately, how many hours will Jeevan alone take to complete the work (rounded off to the nearest integer)?
questions.questionHtml: Amit can complete a piece of work in 5 hours; Jeevan and Paul together can complete It In 4 hours, while Amit and Paul together can complete It In 3 hours. Approximately, how many hours will Jeevan alone take to complete the work (rounded off to the nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
Let total work is 60 units ( LCM of 3,4 and 5 and 18) 

The efficiency of Amit is 60 /5 = 12 units

The efficiency of  Jeevan and Paul together is 60 / 4 = 15 units

The efficiency of Amit and Paul together is 60/3 = 20 units

The efficiency of Amit is 60 /5 = 12 units

The efficiency of paul is 20 - 12= 8units

The efficiency of Jeevan is 15 - 8 = 7 units

 Jeevan alone take to complete the work 60 / 7 = 9 hr(approx)

B. And, indeed, it was the hunters who had found him, coming upon him almost by chance as, bare-limbed and pipe in hand, he was following the flock of the poor goat herd who had brought him up, and whose son he had always fancied himself to be.

C. The lad - for he was only a lad, being but sixteen years of age - was not sorry at their departure, and had flung himself back with a deep sigh of relief on the soft cushions of his embroidered couch, lying there, wild-eyed and open-mouthed, like a brown woodland Faun, or some young animal of the forest newly snared by the hunters.

D. His courtiers had all taken their leave of him, bowing their heads to the ground, according to the ceremonious usage of the day, and had retired to the Great Hall of the Palace, to receive a few last lessons from the Professor of Etiquette; there being some of them who had still quite natural manners, which in a courtier is, I need hardly say, a very grave offence.
questions.solution: In the given question, we can understand that the subject "the young king." The sentence A states the subject of the passage while B concludes the sentence. In between the order of the sentence will be D  and C as it explains the story of the passage in a correct chronological order.
